# Daily Dashboard V0.4.5

## Responsive clock improvements

- Digital time and date typography now scale from the actual clock-face container, so one-column and half-height clocks remain contained at every supported application scale.
- The half-height analog face is larger and removes its hour numerals to preserve a clean, legible face in the compact layout.
- Opening an agenda item now animates a detail pane within the agenda area while smoothly pushing and shrinking the clock face.
- Closing the detail pane reverses the transition before restoring the agenda.
- Reduced-motion preferences disable the transition and animation.

## Verification

- Frontend production build and static/layout/recurrence/map checks
- Rust updater tests and Windows cross-compilation
- All four clock sizes at 1280x400 and 1920x720, each at 75%, 100%, 125%, 150%, and 200% application scaling
